Redesign of Oizo Digital — UX Audit

A full UX audit and redesign of a performance marketing agency's website — transforming a generic site into a bold, high-conversion platform that visualizes speed and results.

Client
Oizo Digital
Duration
Nov – Dec 2025
My Role
UI/UX Designer & UX Auditor
View Live
Get a Quote →
The Challenge

Problem Statement

Oizo Digital's original website suffered from low visual hierarchy, generic copy, and weak conversion signals. Users couldn't quickly understand the agency's core value — scaling revenue through performance marketing — leading to high bounce rates.

The Approach

Solution

A comprehensive UX audit revealed critical issues across usability, visual design, and content strategy. I executed a full redesign: bold dark-mode aesthetic, integrated social proof systems, data visualization of client results, and a restructured service clarity framework.

How I Got There

Design Process

01
UX Audit
Performed a 12-point heuristic evaluation covering navigation clarity, visual hierarchy, CTA effectiveness, trust signals, and responsive behaviour. Documented findings with severity ratings.
02
Content Strategy
Restructured the messaging architecture — leading with results (revenue impact) over features. Rewrote key sections for scanability and clarity.
03
Design System
Built a cohesive dark-mode design system: typography scale, colour tokens, component library. Ensured consistency across all 8 redesigned pages.
04
High-Fidelity UI
Delivered pixel-perfect screens for homepage, services, case studies, and contact pages. Animations and micro-interactions defined for developer handoff.
What Was Achieved

Results

  • 12 UX issues identified and resolved via audit
  • Bold dark-mode redesign with cohesive design system
  • Social proof integration: metrics, client logos & testimonials
  • 18+ Behance views within the first week of publishing
Lessons Learned

Key Takeaways

01
A UX audit before redesign saves weeks of guesswork
02
Agency sites must show results first — process is secondary
03
Dark mode requires rigorous contrast and type hierarchy to work
